questions.text: A planar mechanism has 6 links and 7 revolute lower pairs (J₁ = 7, J₂ = 0). Using Gruebler’s criterion, what is its mobility (DOF)?
A four-bar chain has link lengths 25 mm, 55 mm, 60 mm, and 70 mm. If the 25 mm link is fixed, what mechanism is obtained?
questions.explain: S + L = 25 + 70 = 95 mm ≤ P + Q = 55 + 60 = 115 mm (Grashof satisfied). Fixing the shortest link S produces a double-crank mechanism.

questions.text: In a crank and slotted lever quick-return mechanism, the crank sweeps 240° during the cutting stroke. What is the ratio of cutting time to return time?
questions.explain: Return stroke angle β = 360° − 240° = 120°. Time ratio = α / β = 240° / 120° = 2.0.

questions.text: A 20-tooth pinion rotating at 1,200 rpm meshes externally with an 80-tooth gear. What is the driven gear speed?
A 20-tooth gear rotating at 900 rpm drives a 60-tooth external gear. What is the driven gear speed and direction?
questions.explain: N₁T₁ = N₂T₂, so N₂ = 900 × 20/60 = 300 rpm. External gears turn in opposite directions.

questions.text: An external gear with 24 teeth at 600 rpm drives a 72-tooth gear. What is the output speed?
questions.explain: N₂=N₁T₁/T₂=600×24/72=200 rpm. A single external mesh reverses direction.

questions.text: A planar four-link chain has four revolute lower pairs. What is its generic mobility?
Four links measure 20, 40, 50 and 70 mm. Which statement follows from Grashof’s criterion?
questions.explain: Shortest+longest=20+70=90 and the other pair=40+50=90, so equality is the change-point boundary.

questions.text: A crank sweeps 210° on the cutting stroke and 150° on return at constant speed. What is cutting/return time ratio?
questions.explain: Time is proportional to crank angle at constant angular speed: 210/150=1.40.

questions.text: A point is 0.15 m from a fixed pivot rotating at 8 rad/s. Its normal acceleration is:
questions.explain: a_n=ω²r=8²×0.15=9.6 m/s², directed toward the pivot.
